explanation: Chisel, Saw, Plane, and Sander are all instruments used for shaping or finishing wood. A Splinter is a small, sharp fragment of wood, typically a byproduct or a hazard, not a tool.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: Four of the tokens are recognized as Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Colosseum is a significant ancient landmark but is not one of the original seven wonders; it is often considered one of the New7Wonders of the World.

SALT (with Pepper), KNIFE (with Fork), CUP (with Saucer), and BOW (with Arrow) are all the first items of commonly recognized complementary pairs where each item has a distinct role and function alongside its partner. SHOE, while typically worn in a pair, refers to one of two largely identical or mirror-image items, rather than a distinct complementary item.
